RegistryInstant.description:
One registered instant of the process registry, with where it came from.

Every counting instant, bless moment and window edge is one of these, so a
reader can tell an instant set by hand from one a carrying merge stamped,
and audit either against git. A **pending** instant — ``at`` and ``merge``
both null — is a registration no promotion has carried yet: the PR that
registers a label writes it, and the merge that carries that PR to
``main`` stamps it with its own SHA and committer time.

at.description: The instant, in UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`); null while pending
at.title: At

merge.description: The full SHA of the carrying merge of the label's freeze commit — the promotion merge that made the blessed bytes immutable on `main` — and so the commit the instant is audited against: a bless moment equals its committer time, a counting instant is at or after it. Not the merge that carried a later correction of the instant. Null, with `at`, marks a registration no merge has carried yet
merge.title: Merge

source.description: `merge` where `at` equals `merge`'s committer time, so git re-derives it; `hand` where a maintainer set `at` at or after that committer time (a counting instant forecast at the freeze commit and verified against the merge). A pending instant is `merge`: its carrying merge stamps it
source.title: Source

RegistryLabel.description:
A process label and the counting instant from which its cells count.

The labels before ``proc-v8`` are deliberately absent: their digests were
de-counted when each was superseded, so they open no window.

since.description: The label's counting instant: it opens every window the label newly blesses and closes every window it stops blessing

description:
``process_registry.json`` — the frozen-process registry, as committed data.

The single source of the counting partition's definition:
:mod:`fedcourtsai.process_version` builds its freeze constants from it at
import (``FROZEN_PROCESS_DIGESTS`` from ``blessings``, ``FROZEN_SINCE``
from the current label's ``since``, ``COUNTING_WINDOWS`` from
``windows``, ``EVALUATE_BLESSING_LABELS`` and ``HARNESS_BOUNDARIES``), so
every reader keeps reading those names. Append-only in the same sense as
the freeze record: a successor closes and adds windows, and appends
labels, blessing labels and boundaries, but never rewrites a landed
instant. A pending instant is the one field written twice: null in the PR
that registers it, then stamped once by the merge that carries it.

blessings.description: The digests the current process blesses, one per actor, in order
blessings.title: Blessings

evaluate_blessing_labels.title: Evaluate Blessing Labels

harness_boundaries.description: Every harness boundary dated since the earliest window opened, in the order their carrying commits reached `main`
harness_boundaries.title: Harness Boundaries

labels.description: Every label with a counting window, in order
labels.title: Labels

windows.description: Every counting window, in the order the registry opened them
windows.title: Windows
